text:
vikram.kumar: Quick heads-up  launching a small L40s Dedicated preview in Lagos (ng-west-1) starting today. Target: local latency customers + edge partners. :tada:

amanda.choi: Awesome. Clarify what "preview" means for reservations, billing, and SLAs?

vikram.kumar: Preview = limited pools (small capacity), best-effort availability, no formal SLA yet. We're opening a 14-day reservation window for early customers and applying a soft fair-share to reduce noisy neighbor effects.

sre-bot: [automated] pool-create: dedicated-l40s-ng-west-1-1 created (8x L40s) by infra-deploy. Monitoring enabled.

josh.smith: Ops note: These nodes are subject to background reclaim for capacity optimization. If you buy a 14-day reservation, we won't preempt during that reservation. Non-reserved workloads can be reclaimed during Z-peaks.

sara_retail: Sales Q: what should we tell customers about expected throughput vs our larger us-east pools? Also any pricing differences?

vikram.kumar: For preview, say "subject to availability; typical steady-state throughput ~65-75% of large us-east pools due to smaller node counts." Billing rates are identical; effective unit cost may be higher until we scale.

ops-team: Quick runbook snippet:
```
# reserve a pool (preview)
rcli reserve --region ng-west-1 --gpu L40s --count 2 --days 14
# check pool status
rcli pool status --name dedicated-l40s-ng-west-1-1
# drain before maintenance
rcli pool drain --name dedicated-l40s-ng-west-1-1 --eta 15m
```

josh.smith: Important: autoscaling is disabled for preview. Do not rely on burst scaling for production traffic.

amanda.choi: Can infra produce a 1-pager README for account teams and pre-sales? Ill add to the launch checklist.

vikram.kumar: Yes, pushed a short FAQ in Confluence and pinged partner customers. Internal link: https://redwood.internal/docs/dedicated/ng-west-1-l40s-preview

sre-bot: [automated] metric alert created: l40s-ng-west-1-heatmap (warn 80%, critical 95%).

sara_retail: I'll hold enterprise offers until GA. Small partners can access preview with eng support.

ops-team: If you hit allocation limits, file a ticket and tag it `dedicated-l40s-ng-west-1` and include your reservation id.

vikram.kumar: We'll review telemetry after 72h and share decisions on burst/autoscale / GA timeline. Thanks everyone :rocket:
